BETA Close X Ninety One plc has announced the repurchase of 106,788 ordinary shares between September 7 and September 11, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The weighted average price paid per share was approximately 209.75 pence. These repurchased shares are intended for cancellation. Since June 3, 2026, the company has bought back a total of 7,432,031 shares for £15,923,552.43, leaving 661,240,369 ordinary shares in issue. Morgan Securities plc. Morgan Securities plc by the Company on 3 June 2026 as announced on 3 June 2026. The Company intends to cancel the purchased shares. Since 3 June 2026, the Company has purchased 7,432,031 shares at a cost of £15,923,552.43. Following the above transaction, the Company holds none of its ordinary shares in treasury and has 661,240,369 ordinary shares in issue This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine whether they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules of the Financial Conduct Authority. This announcement does not constitute, or form part of, an offer or any solicitation of an offer for securities in any jurisdiction. Morgan Equities South Africa (Pty) Ltd About Ninety One Ninety One is an independent investment manager, founded in South Africa in 1991. It operates and invests globally and offers a range of active strategies to its global client base. Ninety One is listed on the London and Johannesburg Stock Exchanges.
